## Summary

- What changed?
- Why did it change?

## Type of Change

- [ ] Content update
- [ ] UI/styling change
- [ ] Quiz behavior change
- [ ] Schema/content model change
- [ ] Docs-only change
- [ ] Build/config change

## Affected Areas

- [ ] `src/content/questions/*`
- [ ] `src/content.config.ts`
- [ ] `src/components/quiz/*`
- [ ] `src/pages/*`
- [ ] `src/styles/*`
- [ ] `README.md`
- [ ] `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- [ ] `AGENTS.md`

## Verification

- [ ] Ran `npm run build`
- [ ] Manually checked quiz flow
- [ ] Manually checked affected UI states
- [ ] Verified both themes if styling changed
- [ ] Verified `/quiz` URL-param flow if quiz behavior changed

## Content Checklist

Complete only if question content changed.

- [ ] Category names are consistent
- [ ] Difficulty values are valid
- [ ] Each question has exactly one correct answer
- [ ] Explanations are present and useful
- [ ] New categories were added to `CATEGORY_COLORS` if needed

## Schema Checklist

Complete only if schema or content model changed.

- [ ] Updated `src/content.config.ts`
- [ ] Updated affected content files
- [ ] Updated docs to reflect schema changes
